name: siphon
description: Siphons I/O-heavy work to the Google AI Studio (Gemini) API to save tokens. Hooks block large file reads and redirect to bulk-read/code-write scripts that call Gemini directly.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bulk reads and boilerplate to Gemini
interface.longDescription: Routes I/O-heavy work — reading large files, generating boilerplate — to gemini-2.5-flash through the Google AI Studio API, so the expensive reasoning model never pays for the bytes.
defaultPrompt: Summarize these files with the bulk reader.
